title: Evergreen Retail — Security Workshop Notes + Attestation Pack
content:
Summary

This note captures the outcomes from the on-site security + compliance workshop with Evergreen Retail (March 18, 2025), and bundles the attestation checklist and pointers to evidence we shared during the POC. Purpose: provide a single, workshop-oriented artifact that Evergreen security and audit teams can use to validate our controls for the Private deployment option and to scope next audit steps.

Meeting metadata
- Date: 2025-03-18 (workshop), follow-up evidence uploads: 2025-05-27
- Location: Evergreen corporate campus (conference room + remote Zoom).
- Redwood owner: Priya Natarajan (Solutions Engineering)
- Evergreen contact: Daniel Hsu, Head of Cloud Security
- Attendees: Priya N., Ethan C., Lena P., Marco R.; Daniel H., Sasha L. (Evergreen), Idris K. (Evergreen infra)

Objective
- Walk through technical controls for a Redwood Private deployment inside Evergreen VPC, demonstrate audit evidence, and capture unresolved questions for formal attestation.

Workshop agenda (90m)
1) Intro & scope: which data flows are in-scope (PII tokenization, model inputs are customer-provided, logs classification).
2) Deployment topology review: VPC peering, private control plane, optional on-prem agent.
3) Key controls demo: KMS integration, HSM attestation, network egress policies, audit logging, role-based access controls.
4) Evidence mapping & sample artifacts review.
5) Action items and remediation plan.

High-level findings
- Deployment model: Evergreen elected Private deployment (control plane managed by Redwood, data path pinned to Evergreen VPC). We validated basic VPC peering and subnet allocations in the demo cluster.
- KMS/HSM: Redwood demonstrated integration with Evergreen KMS using the Customer-Managed Key flow (KMIP-compatible HSM tested in dev). Evergreen requests a formal HSM attestation document and nonce-challenge flow for production keys.
- Audit logging: Evidence produced includes structured audit.log files and example CloudTrail mappings from the Private nodes to S3. Logs were redacted to remove customer-specific PII in shared artifacts.
- Access control: RBAC and short-lived certificates shown; Evergreen requested a sample RBAC policy export for their IAM review.

Evidence index (what we handed over)
- evergreen-evidence-20250318.zip (S3 bucket: redwood-evidence/evergreen/)
  - artifacts/cluster-network.pdf -- diagram of VPC/subnet/route tables
  - artifacts/kms-integration.txt -- KMS API call trace and key policy snippet
  - artifacts/hsm-attestation-sample.pdf -- vendor HSM attestation template (redacted)
  - logs/audit.sample.log -- 30-minute live audit log capture (PII redacted)
  - logs/tracing.sample.jsonl -- sample tracing spans for a test inference run
  - configs/rbac-policy-export.yaml -- sample RBAC policy for node and operator roles

Mapping to control objectives (short form)
- Data residency: evidence -> cluster-network.pdf + audit.sample.log (shows all egress endpoints pinned to Evergreen-owned NATs)
- Key management: evidence -> kms-integration.txt + hsm-attestation-sample.pdf
- Authentication & RBAC: evidence -> rbac-policy-export.yaml + short-lived-cert-demo.md
- Audit trail: evidence -> audit.sample.log + tracing.sample.jsonl + CloudTrail-mapping.md (shows S3 write events and log retention rule)

Sample verification steps for Evergreen auditors
1) Confirm S3 artifact upload: check S3 object prefix redwood-evidence/evergreen/2025-03-18 and validate signature (we provided SHA256 sums in the ZIP manifest).
2) Run the nonce challenge for HSM: follow the steps in artifacts/hsm-nonce-flow.md (we provided an example nonce in the zip) and validate key usage logs.
3) Compare RBAC export to Evergreen IAM baseline: use the supplied rbac-policy-export.yaml and map roles to Evergreen AD groups.
4) Reproduce trace: use tracing.sample.jsonl with the Redwood trace parser (link in CONFLUENCE) to confirm tokenized spans and absence of raw prompt content in retention logs.

Outstanding questions (Evergreen requests)
- Formal HSM attestation: Evergreen legal wants vendor-signed attestation for production HSMs (we provided vendor template; need to coordinate vendor engagement).
- Data retention SLAs: clarify how long tokenized inputs are kept in the Private deployment logs by default and where retention can be configured in the Console.
- Cross-account logging: Evergreen asked for an architecture note for cross-account CloudTrail ingestion (their logging org ingestion). We owe a one-page design doc.

Action items (owners and ETA)
- Deliver HSM vendor-signed attestation and coordinate vendor contact (Owner: Marco Ruiz, ETA: 2025-04-11).
- Produce RBAC mapping doc tailored to Evergreen AD groups (Owner: Ethan Cole, ETA: 2025-04-04).
- Upload PoC evidence bundle to S3 and share signed manifest + SHA256 sums (Owner: Priya Natarajan, DONE 2025-05-27).
- Draft cross-account CloudTrail ingestion note (Owner: Lena Park, ETA: 2025-04-08).

Notes on evidence sanitization
- All artifacts provided to Evergreen external reviewers were redacted for customer PII and sanitized to remove live customer prompts. Redaction log attached in artifacts/redaction-record.csv.
- We used sample input sets (evergreen-samples-v1) for tracing and audit captures to avoid exposing customer data.

Low-level technical highlights (for infra auditors)
- Certificate rotation: nodes use short-lived mTLS certs issued by the Redwood control plane CA; rotation is automatic every 6 hours in the demo cluster. See configs/cert-rotation.md in the bundle.
- Network egress policy: egress limited to Evergreen-approved endpoints through NAT gateway with explicit allowlist. Demonstrated that no direct internet egress is permitted from worker subnets in the demo.
- KV cache and in-memory retention: we documented where KV caches are stored (ephemeral on local NVMe) and show eviction policy to avoid long-lived prompt retention. See configs/kv-cache-eviction.txt.

Attestation statement (draft)
Redwood Inference confirms that the artifacts provided in evergreen-evidence-20250318.zip are derived from the Private deployment environment configured for the Evergreen Retail POC on 2025-03-18. Artifacts were sanitized to remove third-party customer PII prior to delivery. The files include network topology diagrams, KMS integration traces, sample audit logs, RBAC policy exports, and HSM attestation templates. Redwood provides these artifacts to support Evergreens internal review and audit processes.

Signature:
Priya Natarajan
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
2025-05-27

Appendix A — Quick commands used during the demo (copied from runbook)
- Verify upload (sha256): sha256sum evergreen-evidence-20250318.zip | tee sha256.txt
- Sample curl to verify private control plane reachability (from Evergreen bastion): curl -k --cacert /etc/redwood/ca.pem https://controlplane.private.evergreen.local/health
- HSM nonce flow (example): echo "nonce:12345" | openssl rsautl -sign -inkey client.key -keyform PEM | base64

Appendix B — Links and references
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE:EVG-SEC-ONBOARD-2025 (detailed runbooks and raw logs)
- Jira: SEC-1234 (Evergreen POC security request backlog)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/release/patch-456 (RBAC export tooling change used in demo)
- S3: s3://redwood-evidence/evergreen/evergreen-evidence-20250318.zip

Notes to self (informal)
- Evergreen legal wants the vendor HSM attestation before they will sign the Dedicated contract. Push vendor contact next week.
- Follow up: schedule a 30-minute call to walk auditors through the nonce attestation steps rather than sending only docs.

End of workshop notes.
